decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Design & Access Statement, Heritage & Townscape Appraisal, Energy Strategy and Planning Statement received 15/04/16; Flood Risk Assessment, Sunlight & Daylight Assessment, Preliminary Ecological Appraisal & Bat Survey and Transport Statement received 19/04/16; Consultation Report received 04/05/16; Drawings: (PL) 002 P1, 003 P1, 004 P1, 007 P1 & 11606se-01 received 19/04/16; (PL) 005 P4 received 19/07/16; (PL) 010 P2, 011 P2, 012 P2, 013 P2, 014 P2 & 015 P2 received 21/12/16; and the documents approved under this variation and the previously discharged details applications) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the materials schedule and supporting information approved under application 01091/23/P8(3), which comprised the following information: 
* Location Plan (PL)001 Rev P1 by Peter Taylor Associates Limited received: 02/11/2017. 
* Annotated drawings 00201 Rev P01, 00202 Rev P01, R00203 Rev P01, 00204 Rev P01, 00205 Rev P01, 00206 Rev P01, and 00207 Rev P01 from Whittam Cox Architects received: 07/12/2017. 
* Material samples received: 07/11/2017, including: Roof tiles - Marley Eternit Clay Tile Heather Blend; RWPs and Gutters - Black; Fascia & Soffits - White; Render - Wetherby System Ltd Colour White; Forticrete Ltd - Artstone (colour Portland); Ibstock Ltd. - Chester Red Blend Brick; and Ibstock Ltd - Bradgate Medium Grey Brick. 
* Sample Schedule Drawing 20-401 Rev P01 by Whittam Cox Architects received: 13/12/2017.

Condition : 3 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9:00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the construction management plan details approved under application 01091/23/P8(5), which comprised the following supporting information: Construction Phase Health, Safety, Environment & Quality Plan Rev 02 dated 03.10.2017 (received 14/12/2017).

Condition : 5 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended), or any order revoking or re-enacting that order, no enlargement of the premises or any additional structures/buildings within the curtilage of the site shall be carried out without the prior permission of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The windows formed in the north flank elevation, to include a kitchen window of flat 3, and windows in the dormer of flat 9, shall be obscurely glazed and top-hung inward opening/non-opening, and thereafter shall only be repaired or replaced in accordance with these specifications.

Condition : 7 - Prior to the first occupation of the development hereby permitted: (A). the sunken terrace to flat 7 shall be wholly enclosed by obscurely glazed screens as shown on drawing no.  (PL) 015 P2; and (B). elevation drawings showing suitable screening along the northern/side edges of the balconies to flats 6 and 9 (to prevent the overlooking of windows at No. 21 Sutton Court Road) shall be submitted to an approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The screening measures shall be implemented as approved prior to the first occupation of the development hereby permitted and thereafter shall only be repaired or replaced in accordance with the agreed details.

Condition : 8 - The bin store as shown on drawing no. (PL) 007 P1 shall be completed and made available for use prior to the occupation of the development and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction.

Condition : 9 - The cycle/mobility scooter store as shown on drawing no. (PL) 007 P1 shall be laid out as approved and completed and made available for use prior to the occupation of the development and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction.

Condition : 10 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the landscaping details approved under application 01091/23/P8(11), which comprised the following supporting information: (PL) 001, Broxap Bench Details, PRI21532-11, and Hard Landscape Proposals PRI21532-12, received on 8 December 2018.

Condition : 11 - If within a period of two years from the date of the planting of any tree, that tree, or any tree planted in replacement for it, is removed, uprooted or destroyed or dies (or becomes, in the opinion of the local planning authority, seriously damaged or defective), another tree of the same species and size as that originally planted shall be planted at the same place, unless the local planning authority gives its written consent to any variation.

Condition : 12 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the tree protection measures approved under application 01091/23/P8(13,14), which contained the following information: Revised Arboricultural Assessment dated 12.12.17, received on 13 December 2017.

Condition : 13 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the tree remedial works set out and approved under application 01091/23/P8(13,14), which contained the following information: Revised Arboricultural Assessment dated 12.12.17, received on 13 December 2017.

Condition : 14 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the boundary treatment details contained within the present application, as shown in the drawings referenced: A-90-401-P01, A-90-401-P02, (PL) 001[P1] and Cover Letter, received on 15 October 2018

Condition : 15 - Prior to first occupation of the development, evidence (e.g. photographs, installation contracts and As-Built certificates under the Standard Assessment Procedure) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority to show that the development has been constructed in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy, and any subsequent approved revisions.

Condition : 16 - Prior to first occupation of the development, evidence (schedule of fittings and manufactures literature) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority to show that the development has been constructed in accordance with the approved internal water use calculations.

Condition : 17 - (a) The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the materials sourcing details set out and approved under application 01091/23/P8(18), which comprised the following documents: Whittam Cox Architects covering letter dated 09.01.2018 with details of green guide specification for proposed key elements & details of insulation materials received on 9 January 2018.

(b) The building(s) shall not be occupied until evidence (e.g. photographs and copies of installation contracts) has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority to demonstrate that the development has been carried out in accordance with the approved details.
Condition : 18 - No plumbing or pipes, other than rainwater pipes, shall be fixed to the external faces of buildings or associated structures.
description: Variation of Condtiion 15 (boundary treatment) to allow changes to the design of the boundary treatment of planning permission 01091/23/P8 dated 31/05/2017 for Demolition of existing property and erection of a three storey building comprising nine senior living apartments (Use Class C3), along with associated landscaping and provision of one car and ten cycle spaces
